description: This Java class defines the ProductOption entity for the shopping system, representing product options with attributes such as type, code, descriptions, and related merchant store information. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping to a database table.

classes.name: ProductOption
classes.description: Entity representing a product option within the shopping system, including its properties, descriptions, associated merchant store, and ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the product option.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the product option.

methods.name: getProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the sort order value of the product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order value of the product option.

methods.name: getProductOptionType
methods.description: Gets the type of the product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionType
methods.description: Sets the type of the product option.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions associated with this product option.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for this product option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsList
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions, converting from the set if necessary.

methods.name: setDescriptionsList
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for this product option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Converts descriptions set to list if not already initialized and returns it.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the unique code for this product option.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the unique code for this product option.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the product option is marked as read-only.

methods.name: setReadOnly
methods.description: Sets the read-only status of the product option.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this product option.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this product option.
